dialog.agent:
I can’t directly trim and stitch the original footage with the connected Magic Hour tools—they regenerate video instead. I also can’t preview this attachment to pick the best moments.

Tell me the timestamp of the main action, and I can give you an exact command to extract a tight 8-second clip without regenerating it.

turns.agent:
My pick: **0:11–0:19**, skipping the opening and ending. I can’t preview the footage, so that’s a best-effort choice—not a verified highlight.

I can’t export a straight cut here, but this command makes it without AI-regenerating the footage:

```bash
ffmpeg -ss 11 -i jet-30s.mp4 -t 8 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -c:a aac jet-8s.mp4
```
